subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I can't wait to __gone camping__ next weekend.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 3 **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In this sentence** 'to' **is used as an infinitive,** not as a preposition.** So, infinitive **'to**' is generally followed by** V1 form of the main verb. **
 
• Here **'go**' is the **v1** form of the main verb and **'camping' **is the present participle form used here. 
 
• As this is a simple sentence and there is no conjunction in this sentence, we must keep only one verb in this sentence and that is** 'wait**' here. '**can't** ' is modal verb used here with the main verb **'wait'**. So **'to go' **is an infinitive ( V1 form after infinitive is not considered as verb ) and '**camping'** is a participle form. As **two v1 form of verb** can not be placed together after infinitive** 'to'.** So "**go camping'** will be the** correct answer.**
 
• **Format = subject + verb + infinitive+ V1 form of verb + participle + object**
 
• Some more examples are as follow
 
 
• Suresh wants to visit Mussoorie **to practice climbing** there.
 
• I can't wait to watch the movie released yesterday. ** **
 
 

 Hence, the correct answer is** I can't wait** **to go camping** **next weekend.**
